beats.text: I will give you three AI automations that can literally help you make eight thousand dollars in just a month.
beats.audience_function: attaches a number and a timeframe to the promise
beats.intention: stop anyone chasing income with AI
key_phrases: eight thousand dollars in just a month

beats.text: And no, you don't have to learn how to code or you don't have to show your face in order to do this.
beats.audience_function: removes the two objections that disqualify most viewers
key_phrases: you don't have to learn how to code
you don't have to show your face

beats.text: So first automation is for law firms. It's an automation that collects new client details, sorts their documents and sends everything to the right person in the team.
beats.audience_function: first automation, tied to a named industry
beats.intention: make the offer concrete and sellable
key_phrases: first automation is for law firms
collects new client details, sorts their documents
sends everything to the right person

beats.text: The second one is for recruitment agencies. This one reads resumes, filters candidates and sends the best ones to the recruiter. This is a huge time saver for a business.
beats.audience_function: second automation with the benefit spelled out
beats.intention: keep the list rhythm and name the value
key_phrases: huge time saver for a business

beats.text: Third is an automation for insurance companies. This one collects customers documents, check what's missing and updates their systems automatically to see who is behind with their payments.
beats.intention: close the list with a back-office case
key_phrases: collects customers documents, check what's missing
who is behind with their payments

beats.text: Now look, these are the automations that businesses can actually understand and they can actually use inside their business.
beats.audience_function: names why these three and not flashier ones
beats.intention: position the list as sellable rather than impressive
key_phrases: automations that businesses can actually understand

beats.text: If you want to get access to these automations for free and you want to learn how to build these high end automations for your clients, just comment the word ready and I'll send you my guide.
beats.audience_function: gives the keyword and stacks two things behind it
key_phrases: get access to these automations for free
learn how to build these high end automations for your clients
